ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixel field (approx. 95%) with localized high-intensity white pixel clusters (approx. 5%) at the distal tips and scattered circular focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black pigmentation across the entire ventral surface; high-contrast white circular spots (mottling/scars) distributed across both lobes; dense high-intensity white/grey calcified geometric clusters at the left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression; interior pixel angle of approximately 100 degrees; vertex is sharp and clearly defined against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the full trailing edge; left lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks (approx. 5-12 pixels) compared to the more moderate serration on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep from the median notch towards the distal tips; distal lobe edges exhibit a steep upward convexity at the termination points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel rings scattered across the mid-section of both lobes; extremely high-density clusters of irregular white calcified rosettes concentrated at the distal lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive acorn barnacle colonization (calcified white clusters) on the posterior-distal edges of both fluke lobes; multiple circular depigmentation scars across the ventral surface.
